q.instruction: 윗글의 내용과 일치하며 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Calypso's mythic allure and its worldwide influence
q.explanation:
글의 핵심 논지는 'The musical style known as calypso—originally named after an African word but later appropriated from Greek mythology—shares a lively, improvisational allure that mirrors the captivating power of the mythic nymph Calypso.'이며 정답 (칼립소의 신비로운 매력)이 이를 반영한다.
【출제의도】 지문의 핵심 내용을 조건에 맞게 영어로 산출/해석하는 표현력·정확성을 평가한다(조건 준수 포함). [핵심 논지: The musical style known as calypso—originally named after an African word but later appropriated from Greek mythology—shares a lively, improvisational allure that mirrors the captivating power of the mythic nymph Calypso.]

q.instruction: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
q.passage:
Words from Mythology calypso A folk song or style of singing of West Indian origin that has a lively rhythm and words that are often made up by the singer.

(A) For many people, the calypso music of the West Indian islands, which was eventually brought to America by singers such as the Andrews Sisters and later Harry Belafonte, has some of the same captivating power as the nymph, though the lyrics that are often improvised to the melodies tend to make fun of local people and happenings. The original name for these songs, however, actually seems to be based on a similar-sounding African word, for which, early in the 20th century, someone began substituting this name from Greek mythology.

(B) • If you take a Caribbean vacation in December, you end up listening to a lot of Christmas carols played to a calypso beat.

(C) In Homer's Odyssey, the nymph Calypso detains Odysseus for seven years on his way home from the Trojan War, using all her wiles to hold him on her lush island.
q.explanation:
원문 전개 순서는 (B) - (C) - (A)이다. 각 단락의 지시어·연결어가 앞 내용을 받아 이 순서로만 논리가 이어진다.
【출제의도】 지문의 핵심 내용을 조건에 맞게 영어로 산출/해석하는 표현력·정확성을 평가한다(조건 준수 포함).
